meta.source: Manual Compilation + Community Wikis (X-Labs, Zeroy, CoD4x)

functions.name: isDefined
functions.description: Checks if a variable is defined (not undefined). Essential for null safety in GSC.

functions.name: iprintln
functions.description: Prints a message to the bottom left of the screen for all players.

functions.name: iprintlnbold
functions.description: Prints a bold message to the center of the screen for all players.

functions.name: println
functions.description: Prints a message to the console (server console or game console).

functions.name: SetClientDvar
functions.description: Sets a client-side dvar (graphics, sound, etc.) for a specific player. Used for per-player settings like r_fullbright.

functions.name: SetClientDvars
functions.description: Sets multiple client-side dvars at once. More efficient than calling SetClientDvar multiple times.

functions.name: playLocalSound
functions.description: Plays a sound locally (only heard by the player).

functions.name: notifyOnPlayerCommand
functions.description: Binds a console command to a notify event. Used for keybind handling in GSC.

functions.name: _SetActionSlot
functions.description: Sets an action slot (like D-pad buttons) to a specific action or empty.

functions.name: getGuid
functions.description: Returns the player's unique GUID (CD key hash).

functions.name: getEntityNumber
functions.description: Returns the entity's index number in the game's entity list.

functions.name: isAlive
functions.description: Checks if the entity (player) is alive.

functions.name: getOrigin
functions.description: Returns the entity's position as a vector [x, y, z].

functions.name: setOrigin
functions.description: Sets the entity's position.

functions.name: getAngles
functions.description: Returns the entity's rotation as a vector [pitch, yaw, roll].

functions.name: setAngles
functions.description: Sets the entity's rotation.

functions.name: getVelocity
functions.description: Returns the entity's current velocity vector.

functions.name: setVelocity
functions.description: Sets the entity's velocity (movement direction and speed).

functions.name: getPlayerAngles
functions.description: Returns the player's view angles as [pitch, yaw, roll].

functions.name: getModel
functions.description: Returns the entity's model name.

functions.name: setModel
functions.description: Sets the entity's model.

functions.name: getTeam
functions.description: Returns the player's team ('allies', 'axis', or 'spectator').

functions.name: sayTeam
functions.description: Sends a message to the player's team.

functions.name: sayAll
functions.description: Sends a message to all players.

functions.name: suicide
functions.description: Kills the player (self).

functions.name: getTime
functions.description: Returns the time in milliseconds since the game/server started.

functions.name: getDvarInt
functions.description: Gets a dvar value as an integer.

functions.name: getDvarFloat
functions.description: Gets a dvar value as a float.

functions.name: getDvar
functions.description: Gets a dvar value as a string.

functions.name: setDvar
functions.description: Sets a server dvar value.

functions.name: setDvarIfUninitialized
functions.description: Sets a dvar only if it hasn't been initialized yet. Useful for default config values.

functions.name: getent
functions.description: Returns the first entity found matching the targetname.

functions.name: getentarray
functions.description: Returns an array of all entities matching the targetname.

functions.name: spawn
functions.description: Spawns a new entity of the specified classname.

functions.name: spawnstruct
functions.description: Creates a new empty struct (container) entity.

functions.name: distance
functions.description: Returns the 3D distance between two points.

functions.name: distance2d
functions.description: Returns the 2D distance (x,y) between two points, ignoring height.

functions.name: bullettrace
functions.description: Performs a bullet trace and returns trace information.

functions.name: bullettracepassed
functions.description: Returns true if a bullet trace doesn't hit anything.

functions.name: sighttracepassed
functions.description: Returns true if there's a line of sight between two points.

functions.name: openPopupMenu
functions.description: Opens a popup menu for the player.

functions.name: openPopupMenuGamepad
functions.description: Opens a gamepad-specific popup menu.

functions.name: closePopupMenu
functions.description: Closes the current popup menu.

functions.name: pingPlayer
functions.description: Pings the player's location (shows a indicator on minimap for teammates).

functions.name: json_encode
functions.description: Encodes a GSC array into a JSON string. (Support varies by client version)

functions.name: json_decode
functions.description: Decodes a JSON string into a GSC array.

functions.name: readfile
functions.description: Reads the contents of a file from the disk (usually restricted to specific directories like scriptdata).

functions.name: writefile
functions.description: Writes content to a file on the disk (usually restricted to specific directories).

functions.name: fileexists
functions.description: Checks if a file exists at the specified path.

functions.name: getping
functions.description: Returns the player's current ping.

functions.name: executecommand
functions.description: Executes a console command on the server.

functions.name: getsystemtime
functions.description: Returns the current system time (timestamp).

functions.name: anglestoforward
functions.description: Converts angles to a forward direction vector.

functions.name: vectornormalize
functions.description: Normalizes a vector (makes length 1) while keeping direction.

functions.name: vectorscale
functions.description: Multiplies a vector by a scalar value.

functions.name: random
functions.description: Returns a random integer from 0 to max-1.

functions.name: randomint
functions.description: Returns a random integer from 0 to max-1.

functions.name: randomfloat
functions.description: Returns a random float from 0 to max.

functions.name: array_size
functions.description: Returns the size of an array.

functions.name: tostring
functions.description: Converts a value to a string.

functions.name: int
functions.description: Converts a value to an integer.

functions.name: float
functions.description: Converts a value to a float.

functions.name: tolower
functions.description: Converts a string to lowercase.

functions.name: toupper
functions.description: Converts a string to uppercase.

functions.name: strtok
functions.description: Splits a string into an array by delimiter.

functions.name: isstring
functions.description: Checks if a value is a string.

functions.name: isarray
functions.description: Checks if a value is an array.

functions.name: isfunction
functions.description: Checks if a function exists.

functions.name: playfx
functions.description: Plays a local effect at the specified position.

functions.name: playfxontag
functions.description: Plays a local effect attached to a specific tag on an entity.

functions.name: playsound
functions.description: Plays a sound at the entity's location.

functions.name: objective_add
functions.description: Adds or updates an objective marker on the map.

functions.name: objective_delete
functions.description: Deletes an objective marker.

functions.name: objective_player
functions.description: Makes an objective visible only to a specific player.

functions.name: newClientHudElem
functions.description: Creates a HUD element visible only to a specific player.

functions.name: newHudElem
functions.description: Creates a HUD element visible to all players.

functions.name: precacheShader
functions.description: Precaches a shader/image for use in HUDs or objectives.

functions.name: precacheString
functions.description: Precaches a localized string for display.

functions.name: precacheMenu
functions.description: Precaches a menu for use.

functions.name: precacheHeadIcon
functions.description: Precaches a head icon (minimap indicator).
